description: Données GNSS is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Le GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System), ou système de positionnement par satellite, regroupe tous les systèmes de navigation satellitaire. Il vous permet de connaître votre position, n’importe où sur le territoire. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Its tags are Altimétrie, DGIG, Géodésie, Planimétrie, Repère. It offers 5 resource(s) in ESRIREST, HTML, PDF, RINEX, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
